requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of a production sample of the rear combination lamp ESA: verify that an approval mark conforming to paragraph 5.3 is affixed. Pass if the mark is present, or if the lamp is only supplied built into vehicles approved as units under R10.

requirements.text: Markings on the ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) in conformity with paragraph 5.3. need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the ESA sample and drawings: confirm the markings conform to paragraph 5.3. A marking that is hidden when the lamp is installed in the vehicle is acceptable; pass if the paragraph 5.3 marking is present, regardless of visibility after installation.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA(s) and its electrical/electronic system(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Design review plus the ESA EMC tests of UN R10 (radiated/conducted emissions and immunity) with the lamp fitted and operated as in normal use; pass if all applicable R10 limits and immunity criteria are met.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for radiated emissions.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband radiated emissions per UN R10 Annex 7 and Annex 8 with all lamp functions energised; pass if emissions are below the R10 ESA reference limits.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for conducted emissions.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions on the supply lines per UN R10 Annex 10 while switching each lamp function; pass if the R10 conducted emission requirements are met.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Expose ESA to radiated fields per UN R10 Annex 9 with lamps operating; pass if no degradation of the lamp functions (no unintended switching, flicker or loss of light output) per test plan criteria.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Apply conducted transients on supply lines per UN R10 Annex 10 with lamps operating; pass if lamp functions show no malfunction per the specified functional status/pass criteria.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 30 to 75 MHz; pass if measured values are below the limit decreasing logarithmically from 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 75 to 400 MHz; pass if measured values are below the limit increasing logarithmically from 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m per Appendix 6.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband type approval limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if measured values are below 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement over 30 to 1,000 MHz with all lamp functions operating; pass if all measured values are below the limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission test, 30-75 MHz, all lamp functions operating; pass if measured level below the log-decreasing limit 52→42 dBµV/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission test, 75-400 MHz, all lamp functions operating; pass if measured level below the log-increasing limit 42→53 dBµV/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission test, 400-1,000 MHz, all lamp functions operating; pass if measured level below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband results over 30-1,000 MHz against the 6.6.2.1 limit curve; pass if all measured values are below the limits.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be +75 V.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 per Annex 10 on 12 V supply; pass if the measured positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be -100 V.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 per Annex 10 on 12 V supply; pass if the measured negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be +150 V.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 per Annex 10 on 24 V supply; pass if the measured positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +150 V.

requirements.text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines shall be -450 V.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 per Annex 10 on 24 V supply; pass if the measured negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -450 V in magnitude.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 60 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20-400 MHz: apply 60 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 50 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20-400 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 50 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency band shall be 75 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20-200 MHz: apply 75 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency band shall be 62,5 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell, 20-200 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 62,5 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the BCI method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 60 mA.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 BCI, 20-400 MHz: inject 60 mA over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the BCI method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 50 mA.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 BCI, 20-400 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 50 mA. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band shall be 30 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80-2,000 MHz: apply 30 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band shall be 25 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 80-2,000 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 25 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be 10 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000-6,000 MHz: apply 10 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be 8 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE, 2,000-6,000 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 8 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band shall be 21 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF-2,000 MHz: apply 21 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band shall be 18 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF-2,000 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 18 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the test level in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be 7 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000-6,000 MHz: apply 7 V/m over >90 % of test frequencies. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When the immunity of the rear combination lamp ESA is tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be 6 V/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, 2,000-6,000 MHz: confirm no frequency is tested below 6 V/m. Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 immunity tests: monitor the rear position, stop and reversing lamp outputs during exposure (e.g. no flicker, dropout or unintended activation). Pass: no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of the ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient tests on the supply lines (ISO 16750-2 starting profile; ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at the Table 3a/3b levels. Pass: each test is performed and the functional status required for that test is met.

requirements.text: The starting profile for the ESA shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 16750-2 starting profile test. Assess lamp behaviour using the ISO 16750-1 functional status classes. Pass: the class required by Table 3a is achieved.

requirements.text: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse tests. Assess lamp functions using the ISO 7637-1 FPSC. Pass: the FPSC required by Table 3b is achieved.

requirements.text: For ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the ESA shall be tested with the starting profile at immunity test level II for 12 V systems and II for 24 V systems with 10 pulses. For immunity related functions the ESA shall meet functional status B (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) or C (for other ESA). For functions not related to immunity related functions it shall meet functional status D.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 16750-2 starting profile at level II (12 V and 24 V), 10 pulses, lamp functions operating. Pass: status B for functions that must work during engine start, otherwise C; status D for non-immunity-related functions.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested with test pulse 1 at -75 V for 12V systems and -450 V for 24V systems with 500 pulses, and shall meet FPSC III for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 1: -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses. Pass: FPSC III.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested with test pulse 2a at +37 V for 12V systems and +37 V for 24V systems with 500 pulses, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a: +37 V (12 V and 24 V), 500 pulses. Pass: FPSC I for immunity-related lamp functions; FPSC III for other functions.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested with test pulse 2b at +10 V for 12V systems and +20 V for 24V systems with 10 pulses, and shall meet FPSC II for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b: +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses. Pass: FPSC II for immunity-related functions; FPSC III for other functions.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested with test pulse 3a at -112 V for 12V systems and -150 V for 24V systems for a test duration of 1 h, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a: -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V), applied for 1 h. Pass: FPSC I for immunity-related functions; FPSC III for other functions.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested with test pulse 3b at +75 V for 12V systems and +150 V for 24V systems for a test duration of 1 h, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b: +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V), applied for 1 h. Pass: FPSC I for immunity-related functions; FPSC III for other functions.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design and component list for any electronic oscillator (e.g. switching LED driver, PWM, microcontroller clock) above 9 kHz. Pass if none is present, so narrowband emission testing under 6.6.2/Annex 8 is waived. Otherwise testing per Annex 8 is required.

requirements.text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Assess the lamp functions against the immunity related functions criteria. The stop and rear position signalling functions are typically immunity related. Pass for the exemption only if no function is immunity related. Otherwise perform radiated immunity testing per Annex 9 with no disturbance of signalling functions.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review the schematic for internal switches, switched operation and inductive loads (e.g. buck/boost driver inductors). Pass for the exemption if none apply. Otherwise measure transient conducted emissions on the supply lines per Annex 10 against the paragraph 6.7 limits.

requirements.text: The radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA, for a 120 kHz bandwidth, shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) in the 30-75 MHz frequency band given by E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30), where F is the frequency in MHz (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions of the lamp ESA per the R10 ESA broadband method (Annex 7) at 120 kHz bandwidth from 30 to 75 MHz with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA, for a 120 kHz bandwidth, shall not exceed the limit E (dBµV/m) in the 75-400 MHz frequency band given by E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75), where F is the frequency in MHz (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions of the lamp ESA per the R10 ESA broadband method (Annex 7) at 120 kHz bandwidth from 75 to 400 MHz with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA, for a 120 kHz bandwidth, shall not exceed the limit E = 63 dBµV/m in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions of the lamp ESA per the R10 ESA broadband method (Annex 7) at 120 kHz bandwidth from 400 to 1,000 MHz with all lamp functions operating; pass if every measured level is at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation) in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 method referenced in para 6.6.2.1 with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 30-75 MHz. Pass if every measured value is at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation) in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 method referenced in para 6.6.2.1 with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 75-400 MHz. Pass if every measured value is at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation) in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall be E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 method referenced in para 6.6.2.1 with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 400-1,000 MHz. Pass if every measured value is at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 para 2.1; operate all lamp functions in normal mode at maximum load during the emission scan; pass if the operating state is documented and maintained throughout the measurement.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used for the rear combination lamp ESA test.
requirements.test_case: If OATS is used, verify site compliance with CISPR 16-1-4 (Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).

requirements.text: The broadband emission limits shall apply to the rear combination lamp ESA throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 scan 30–1,000 MHz in ALSE/OATS; pass if emissions are below the para 6.5 broadband limits throughout the range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for measuring the rear combination lamp ESA emissions, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied, the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation being for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report: peak readings compared with quasi-peak limits plus 20 dB correction per CISPR 12.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the radiated narrowband emission tests.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 2: operate the lamp with its functions energised in normal operation, preferably all functions at maximum load; check that the operating state is recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) may be used for the radiated narrowband emission test of the ESA, provided that it complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 3.2: if OATS used, verify site validation to CISPR 16-1-4 (Figure 1 of appendix to Annex 7).

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits for the ESA shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 4.1: scan 30-1,000 MHz; pass if emissions are below the para 6.6.2.1 limits throughout the range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements of the ESA shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 4.2: verify average detector setting in test report.

requirements.text: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments may be used for conformity measurements provided that they meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para 4.3: verify instrument compliance with CISPR 16-1-1.

requirements.text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9 being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review test plan: selected ISO 11452 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz; pass if no frequency gap.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of the ESA shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check test report references ISO 11452-1 for frequency range and general conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 tests: verify all lamp functions energised in normal operation during exposure.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Sweep 20–6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 steps; lamp functions shall remain unaffected.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify generator settings: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth over 20–400 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify generator settings: PM2, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700–3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Verify generator settings: PM3, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380–2,700 MHz and 3,100–6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check step size and dwell time in test report against ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: ISO 11451-4 in-vehicle BCI, substitution method, probe at 150 mm from ESA.

requirements.text: The immunity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply shall be ensured, and conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited, using the test method of Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 method: perform the ISO 7637-2 transient immunity tests, the ISO 16750-2 starting profile test and the ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement on the supply lines. Pass when immunity and emission meet the applicable criteria.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to each supply line and to each connection operationally linked to supply, with the lamp functions operating. Pass when the lamp functions show no unacceptable degradation according to the immunity criteria.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines and connected pins, unless the lamp is exclusively for electric vehicles without a 12/24 V starter motor. Pass when the lamp functions meet the immunity criteria during and after the profile.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of drawing and sample: dedicated marking area large enough for approval marking and markings of 3.3.3.2 to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: All markings on the rear combination lamp shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check of legibility; rub/durability test of markings (e.g. with water- and solvent-soaked cloth); markings remain legible and intact.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark per Annex 7 arrangement; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: circle with letter "E" and country number present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: 4–6 digit sequential number present, matches approval number, located close to the E-mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: identification symbols for each approved function (e.g. R, S, AR) present per 3.2.4.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "148R" followed by correct two-digit series of amendments.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of left and right units: horizontal arrow present indicating mounting position.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check arrow direction on each handed unit against installed orientation; arrow points outwards from vehicle.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: If reversing lamp approved with reduced light distribution of two lamps: verify arrow points outwards from vehicle.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: If function approved as assembly of two independent lamps: verify "D" to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.test_case: If function is part of an interdependent lamp system: verify "Y" to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: If approved with reduced light distribution per Annex 3 §1.1: verify vertical downward arrow from horizontal segment.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking present on lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: applicant trade name or mark present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range marked on lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear and/or a variable luminous intensity control and/or a secondary operating mode.
requirements.test_case: If lamp has electronic control gear, variable intensity control or secondary mode: verify rated voltage or range marked.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If external control gear exists: visual inspection for identification number and manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect design: marking on a part not separable from the light-emitting lens.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Install lamp on vehicle (or mock-up); verify approval marking visible with lamp fitted or with boot lid/door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If lens is detachable: verify approval marking on both lens and housing.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device body: only its own function approval marking present.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking, trade name, voltage marking and other applicable markings located on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: If single approval mark used: verify mark visible after installation on vehicle.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect design: removing any light-transmitting part necessarily removes the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark components; pass if not smaller than the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required by the relevant Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by inspection and testing that each lamp function meets all requirements of UN R148 paragraphs 4. and 5. (general specifications, photometry, colour, etc.); pass if all applicable sub-requirements are met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector).
requirements.test_case: Review of the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 (series of amendments in force at the time of application) and the referenced Annexes; each applicable provision must be checked against the lamp design documentation and samples; pass if all applicable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 pertinent to each lamp of the rear combination lamp and to the vehicle category M1 on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: For each lamp function, identify the UN R48 provisions relevant to M1 that are verifiable at lamp level (e.g. geometric visibility, orientation and colour), then verify them by inspection or photometric/goniometric measurement on the lamp sample; pass if all lamp-level verifiable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The lamps (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vibration/durability check of the complete lamp in its normal mounting configuration representative of normal conditions of use, followed by functional check and photometric/colorimetric re-measurement; pass if all functions operate satisfactorily and still meet the R148 prescribed photometric and colour characteristics, with no loosening, cracking or damage.

requirements.text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation and the lamp markings: if the rear position lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D", confirm the "D" approval covers only the rear position lamp function. Pass if no "D" marking is applied to a function not listed in 4.4.1, such as the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable to stop lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation and the lamp markings: if the stop lamp is an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D", confirm the "D" approval covers only the stop lamp function. Pass if no "D" marking is applied to a function not listed in 4.4.1.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable to rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation and the lamp markings: if the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", confirm the "Y" approval covers only the rear position lamp function. Pass if no "Y" marking is applied to a function not listed in 4.4.2, such as the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable to stop lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation and the lamp markings: if the stop lamp is an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", confirm the "Y" approval covers only the stop lamp function. Pass if no "Y" marking is applied to a function not listed in 4.4.2.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, are permitted.
requirements.test_case: Design review of circuit/PCB: confirm common light source and permanent intensity-regulation system for the reciprocally incorporated functions; pass if the arrangement matches this description.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Design review of LED/PCB layout and vehicle specification: pass if the functions use multiple light sources, or the intended vehicle has a lamp-failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of the rear position lamp may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of lamp and full photometric/colorimetric testing of the rear position lamp with logo; pass if at most one logo is present and all function requirements are met.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed in the apparent surface of the rear position lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and applicant statement per paragraph 3.1.2.2.(f); pass if the logo is solely the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure projected enclosed logo area in the direction of the reference axis; pass if ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: Stop lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of stop lamp apparent surface; pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: Reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of reversing lamp apparent surface; pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: In a single lamp of the rear combination lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit diagram and LED wiring (series strings) and confirm which LED groups are treated as one light source for the failure assessment. Pass if the grouping used in the failure assessment matches the actual wiring.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the rear position lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.10.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Disable each light source (or LED group) in turn and measure on a goniophotometer at the Annex 3 grid points. Pass if all minimum intensities are still met and the maxima are not exceeded with all sources on. Alternatively, verify that a failure signal for the tell-tale is produced for each single failure and that the communication form carries the corresponding note.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the stop lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.7.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Disable each light source (or LED group) in turn and carry out photometry at the Annex 3 grid points. Pass if all minimum intensities are still met and the maxima are not exceeded with all sources on. Alternatively, verify that a failure tell-tale signal is generated for each single failure and that the communication form carries the corresponding note.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the reversing lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraph 6.4.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Disable each light source (or LED group) in turn and carry out photometry at the Annex 3 grid points. Pass if all minimum intensities are still met and the maxima are not exceeded with all sources on. Alternatively, verify that a failure tell-tale signal is produced for each single failure and that the communication form carries the corresponding note.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the luminous intensity. Pass if the steady-intensity requirements of the respective category are fulfilled automatically, without any manual intervention.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and carry out photometry. Pass if the steady-intensity requirements of the respective category are met automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and carry out photometry. Pass if the steady-intensity requirements of the respective category are met automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Design review of the light source types fitted against approval documentation; pass if only approved replaceable light sources, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources are used.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp, as a light signalling device, shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Radiated and conducted emission tests on the lamp/vehicle (EMC, e.g. per UN R10); pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Attempt fitting the module in all possible orientations/positions; pass if it fits only in the designated correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt removal of the module by hand without tools; pass if removal is only possible with tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of module construction for accessibility of internal components; pass if module cannot be tampered with.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit replaceable UN approved light sources into the module seat and the module into standard holders, with tools; pass if interchange is impossible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt swapping modules of different functions/characteristics within the housing, with tools; pass if no swap is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another bearing the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; pass if all photometric requirements are met.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Supply the lamp at 13.5 V (12 V system) or the applicable value at the connector during testing; pass if the measured voltage at the lamp matches.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp with the control gear under the conditions declared by the applicant; pass if the test conditions match the declaration.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp under the conditions declared by the applicant (voltage/current); pass if the test conditions match the declaration.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity at HV on both samples per function; pass if ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan all directions where the lamp is visible on both samples; pass if no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure at each Annex 3 grid point on both samples; pass if each value is ≥ the minimum × the percentage, or ≥ the specified value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles on both samples; pass if all values are ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Check the intensity between grid directions per Annex 3; pass if the local-variation criteria are met.

requirements.text: If the applicant requests the additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1cd, and this additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
requirements.test_case: On request, measure the field H 165°–180° outboard, V -2.5° to +5°, optionally with the vehicle body; pass if the maximum is ≤ 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop+position together and position alone at grid points within ±5° V, ±10° H; pass if the ratio is ≥ 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect, and spot-measure if needed, the emitted colour outside the Annex 3 grid field for each function. Pass: no abrupt colour change is observed.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Energise the lamp with its own LED light sources installed, under paragraph 4.8 conditions, and measure the chromaticity. Pass: the colour meets the limits for each function.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp of category R1 (steady) supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd, in accordance with Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if the minimum luminous intensity is at least 4 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp of category R1 (steady) supplied shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp, or 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if intensity ≤ 17 cd (single) or ≤ 8.5 cd (marked "D"), with up to 60 cd allowed below 5° down when reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp of category R2 (variable) supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd, in accordance with Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if the minimum luminous intensity is at least 4 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp of category R2 (variable) supplied shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp, or 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if intensity ≤ 42 cd (single) or ≤ 21 cd (marked "D"), with up to 60 cd allowed below 5° down when reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-I and Table A2-1, in accordance with Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the light distribution grid per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(c), Figure A3-I and Table A2-1 on both samples; pass if all grid point requirements are met

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility, in accordance with Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement within the angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 4.8.3.1.(d); pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd in all directions

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify behaviour under failure conditions per paragraph 4.6; pass if provisions of paragraph 4.6 are met

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within the red colour boundaries

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples on the reference axis; pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S1 (steady) stop lamp used as a single lamp shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement over the light distribution of both samples; pass if no value exceeds 260 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S1 (steady) stop lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 1.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples of a lamp marked D; pass if no value exceeds 130 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at the Table A2-1 grid points on both samples; pass if each point meets its required percentage of the minimum.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S1 (steady) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement within the Figure A3-I geometric visibility field on both samples; pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples on the reference axis; pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp used as a single lamp shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples in the highest intensity condition; pass if no value exceeds 730 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 3.65∙10^2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples of a lamp marked D; pass if no value exceeds 365 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall meet the standard light distribution defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at the Table A2-1 grid points on both samples; pass if each point meets its required percentage.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (day) within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement in day mode within the Figure A3-I field on both samples; pass if all values ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of a category S2 (variable) stop lamp shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 7∙10^-2 cd (night) within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement in night mode within the Figure A3-I field on both samples; pass if all values ≥ 0.07 cd.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify failure behaviour per paragraph 4.6 (e.g. simulated LED failure); pass if paragraph 4.6 provisions are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates fall within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per para 4.8.3.1 and Table 10; pass if all values comply.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on the reference axis per para 4.8.3.1.(a); pass if ≥ 80 cd.

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR in or above the h-plane shall be 3.00∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of all directions in or above the H-plane per para 4.8.3.1.(b); pass if ≤ 300 cd.

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR below the h-plane, down to 5°D, shall be 6.00∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan between H-plane and 5°D; pass if ≤ 600 cd.

requirements.text: The maximum luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR below 5°D shall be 8.00∙10^3 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan below 5°D; pass if ≤ 8000 cd.

requirements.text: The standard light distribution of the reversing lamp of category AR shall be as defined in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at grid points of Figure A3-V per para 4.8.3.1.(c); pass if each point meets its percentage of the minimum.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at 30° inwards; pass if ≥ 25 cd.

requirements.text: The failure provisions of paragraph 4.6 shall apply to the reversing lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify failure behaviour per paragraph 4.6 with simulated LED failures; pass if paragraph 4.6 criteria are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: For the lamps in series production, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples at the prescribed test points per Annexes 2 and 3; pass if each measured value is within 20 per cent unfavourable deviation of the prescribed value.

requirements.text: For the required minimum value of 7∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to 5∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 3∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if values are not below 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) / 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: For the required minimum value of 6∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to 4∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if values are not below 4∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) / 2∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: For the required minimum value of 3∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to 2∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 1∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if values are not below 2∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) / 1∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: For the required minimum value of 7∙10-2 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to 5∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if values are not below 5∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) / 3∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: For the required minimum value of 5∙10-2 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to 3∙10-2 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 2∙10-2 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if values are not below 3∙10-2 cd (20 per cent level) / 2∙10-2 cd (30 per cent level).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 45° inboard / 80° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check of the lamp against Annex 2, Part A, Table A2-1 (right-side unit; mirrored for the left). Pass if the light-emitting surface is visible at 45° inboard and 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard below the H-plane, the reduced angles being used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the mounting height of the H-plane on the M1 vehicle is below 750 mm, then verify visibility below the H-plane per Table A2-1 note a. Pass if visible at 20° inboard and 80° outboard.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check per Annex 2, Table A2-1. Pass if the lamp is visible at 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed H-plane height is below 750 mm, then perform a goniometric check per Table A2-1 note b. Pass if the lamp is visible at 15° above and 5° below.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 45° inboard / 45° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check per Annex 2, Part A, Table A2-1. Pass if the lamp is visible at 45° inboard and 45° outboard.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard below the H-plane, the reduced angles being used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the installed H-plane height is below 750 mm, then verify visibility below the H-plane per Table A2-1 note a. Pass if visible at 20° inboard and 45° outboard.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check per Annex 2, Table A2-1. Pass if the lamp is visible at 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.

requirements.text: For stop lamps (S1, S2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above / 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed H-plane height is below 750 mm, then perform a goniometric check per Table A2-1 note b. Pass if the lamp is visible at 15° above and 5° below.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of a rear position lamp pair (MR) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: If the lamp is approved as MR, perform a goniometric check per Table A2-1. Pass if all the stated angles are met for the installed mounting height.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of a stop lamp pair (MS) shall have minimum horizontal angles of 0° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: If the lamp is approved as MS, perform a goniometric check per Table A2-1. Pass if all the stated angles are met for the installed mounting height.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement of the rear position lamp and stop lamp, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Photometric goniometer measurement relative to the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°) through the centre of reference; compute the required minimum per direction as the percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured value is at least that value.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer-declared mounting height. If it is ≤ 750 mm, perform photometric verification of the downward directions only to 5° down. Pass if all points within the reduced field meet the minima.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer-declared mounting height and the stop lamp category. If it is ≤ 750 mm, verify photometry downward only to 5° down. Pass if all points within the reduced field meet the minima.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity of the lamp in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Perform a goniometric scan between the grid points of the applicable figure. Pass if every intermediate direction is at least the lowest minimum of the surrounding grid lines.

requirements.text: In the case of the reversing lamp, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reversing lamp beam. If substantial local variations are seen, measure between adjacent measuring directions of Figure A3-V. Pass if every value is ≥ 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, where the values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at all Figure A3-I points. Pass if each point is at least the stated percentage of the required minimum for the rear position lamp from the applicable table.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, where the values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7).
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at all Figure A3-I points. Pass if each point is at least the stated percentage of the Table 7 minimum for the stop lamp category.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, where the values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd, the directions H = 0° and V = 0° corresponding to the axis of reference and passing through the centre of reference.
requirements.test_case: Align the reversing lamp to the axis of reference through the centre of reference. Measure intensity at each Figure A3-V point. Pass if each value is ≥ the cd value shown.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the rear combination lamp shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed boundaries.

requirements.text: In any test of conformity carried out by the manufacturer, equivalent methods may be used with the consent of the competent authority responsible for approval tests, provided the manufacturer proves that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check for authority consent and equivalence evidence for any alternative method.

requirements.text: From a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, the differences of the mass-produced rear combination lamp from the requirements of this Regulation shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Dimensional and mechanical inspection of randomly sampled production lamps against the approved drawings; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing tolerances.
