requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any rear combination lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test per paragraph 4.8. on randomly chosen production lamps; pass if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the rear combination lamp shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement under the conditions of paragraph 4.9.; pass if chromaticity coordinates are within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1: operate reversing lamp, measure intensity distribution after 1 min and after 10 min (or calculate from distribution after photometric stability using HV ratios at 1 min, 10 min and stability); pass if all test points are within min/max limits.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity at 1 min, 10 min and at photometric stability; scale the stabilised distribution by the HV ratios; pass if calculated values at all test points meet min/max requirements.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2: measure intensity distribution after 1 min and after 30 min (or at photometric stability); pass if all test points are within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2: measure intensity distribution after 1 min and after 30 min (or at photometric stability); pass if all test points are within min/max limits.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp and the stop lamp after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity after 1 min and after 30 min or at stabilisation; scale distribution by HV ratio; pass if calculated 1 min values meet min/max requirements at all test points.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as the reference coordinate.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity at 4 s after switch-on (or derive distribution via HV ratio from para 1 measurement); pass if min/max requirements met, or deemed compliant for LED-only per para 2.1.2.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as the reference coordinate.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity at 0.2 s after switch-on (or derive distribution via HV ratio); pass if min/max requirements met, or deemed compliant for LED-only per para 2.1.2.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as the reference coordinate.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity at 0.2 s after switch-on (or derive distribution via HV ratio); pass if min/max requirements met, or deemed compliant for LED-only per para 2.1.2.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of samples and drawings: a marking space of sufficient size for the UI or approval marking plus the markings of 3.3.4.2 is present.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for legibility; durability check (e.g. rubbing with water- and solvent-soaked cloth). Pass: markings remain legible and intact.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking dimensions and compare with the value of "a" in Table 1 (arrangement per Annex 10 examples). Pass: dimensions meet Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking. Pass: circled "E" with the distinguishing number of the approving country is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: 4–6 digit sequential number matches the approval number and is placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: identification symbol (e.g. class IA) per paragraph 3.2.5 is present in the marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at approval is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available, provided that the Unique Identifier mark follows the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If UI used: visual comparison with Figure I format. Pass: UI mark conforms to the Figure I format.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: applicant's trade name or mark is present on the device.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Review manufacturer's prescribed rotation angles; if orientation is ambiguous, visually check "TOP" is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the device: approval marking/UI, trade name and TOP (if required) are clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle or representative fixture and verify visually that the single approval mark/UI is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check: each removable light-transmitting part (outer lens, reversing insert) cannot be removed without also removing the approval mark/UI.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark component sizes and compare with minimum sizes required by each pertinent UN Regulation (e.g. R148, R150). Pass: no component smaller than the smallest required individual mark size.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Production samples tested against R150 paragraphs 4 and 5 requirements (photometric, colorimetric, physical); pass if samples conform to approved type.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications", and in the Annexes referenced in those sections, of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to the retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Review the applicable UN R48 series of amendments in force at the time of application. Check the retro-reflector against R48 sections 5 and 6 and the referenced Annexes (e.g. 6.14 rear retro-reflector, non-triangular), including position, geometric visibility, orientation and colour. Pass if all requirements that can be verified at device approval are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to the retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Identify the R48 requirements relevant to a rear non-triangular retro-reflector on M1 vehicles that can be verified at device level. Verify them by document review and measurement on the device as mounted per the applicant's installation drawing. Pass if all feasible requirements are verified and met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and inspection of samples, plus the durability/environmental tests of UN R150 Annexes for retro-reflectors; pass if photometric and physical function is retained after testing.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual and design inspection of production samples; pass if no defect impairing operation or maintenance in good condition is found.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Manual attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components without tools; pass if components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if the surface can be easily cleaned.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if the surface is not rough and any protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the assembled lamp in its mounted condition; pass if the inner surface of the retro-reflector cannot be accessed in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, provided that they are so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt under normal-use conditions; pass if optical unit and filter cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Material/design documentation review and inspection of the optical unit and filter; pass if colour is not obtained by paint or varnish.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the colorimetric set-up: CIE Standard Illuminant A source, divergence angle 1/3°, illumination angle β1=β2=0°. If a colourless surface reflection is observed, use the angle from Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1. Pass: the set-up is documented as conforming.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Illuminate the device with CIE Illuminant A under the P4 geometry. Measure the x, y chromaticity of the retro-reflected light with a spectroradiometer or colorimeter. Pass: the coordinates lie within the UN R48 red night-time colour boundaries for retro-reflected light.

requirements.text: For testing the daytime colour of the retro-reflective device, the material shall be illuminated by the CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664- 2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) using geometry (45a:0) or (0:45a) as described in Part 2 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure the daytime colour of the retro-reflector material under the CIE D65 illuminant, using (45a:0) or (0:45a) geometry per Annex 4, Part 2. Pass: the test is performed under these conditions and the result is recorded for comparison with the applicable daytime colour limits.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of shape and dimensions per Annex 5 on all ten samples (Table 4); pass if all Annex 5 requirements are met.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1 in the test sequence of Table 4; pass if RI values meet Table 3 and colour is within UN R48 night-time limits.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the Table 4 test sequence (heat, water, fuels, oils, corrosion, rear face, stability in time, weathering); pass if samples pass visual inspections and subsequent colour/photometry checks.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2 (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each group's tests; pass if within red night-time limits of UN R48.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., the verification being performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each group's tests; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx (red Class IA/IB).

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at α = 20', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 200 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at α = 20', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at α = 1°30', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at α = 1°30', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 2.8 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value for a red retro-reflector of Class IA or IB must be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angles β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry at α = 1°30', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Photometric scan within the solid angle bounded by (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°); pass if no RI value falls below the applicable Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm mounting height of H plane on vehicle; if < 750 mm, verify downward RI angles only to 5° and check Table 3 minima within that range.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of reflected light per paragraph 4.2.1; pass if within UN R48 red night-time colour limits.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements for the retro-reflective device shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Dimensional/geometric inspection of production samples against approved type; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of randomly chosen production retro-reflector per R150 methods; pass if no value is more than 20 % below prescribed minimum

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the retro-reflective device shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed red boundaries

requirements.text: In any test of conformity of the retro-reflective device carried out by the manufacturer, equivalent methods may be used with the consent of the Type Approval Authority, provided the manufacturer proves that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review of equivalence evidence and authority consent for any alternative method

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate about the reference axis at β = 0°/0°, α = 20'; find minimum RI; pass if minimum RI ≥ value of paragraph 5.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate ±5° about the reference axis at β = 0°/0°, α = 20'; pass if RI ≥ prescribed value at every position.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify source calibration to CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector's illuminating surface from an observation distance of 10 m. Pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 1: condition the retro-reflector sample for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C. Pass: the conditioning sequence is completed as specified, ready for the inspection in para. 3.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1 para. 3: after the heat conditioning and cooling, visually examine the retro-reflector. Pass: no visible cracking or appreciable distortion of the device, especially of its optical component.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 §1.1: strip removable parts, immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface. Pass: assessed per §1.2/§1.3 (no water on the reflecting surface).

requirements.text: The retro-reflector sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 §1.1: immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C. Pass: assessed per §1.2/§1.3.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: After the Annex 6 Part 2 §1.1 immersion sequence, visually inspect the reflecting surface. Pass: no visible water on the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied to the retro-reflective device of Class IB or IIIB to verify resistance to water penetration.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 moisture test (para. 2) and dust exposure test (para. 2.3) on request of manufacturer; pass if both tests' evaluation criteria are met

requirements.text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform, with a collector height of 100 mm and an inside diameter of a minimum of 140 mm.
requirements.test_case: Collector measurement: rate 2.5 to 4.1 mm/min; collector 100 mm high, ID ≥ 140 mm

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Energise rear position, stop and reversing functions at design voltage, 5 min ON / 55 min OFF during water spray

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Run 12 h spray with 12 operating cycles

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation and no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after drain, including tapping and tilting; pass if no standing pool of water

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: 5 h exposure; agitation 2–15 s every 15 min with settling between

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 (ISO 9227:2017 saline mist). Pass if photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits after the test.

requirements.text: The lamp, since the retro-reflective device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts. Expose to saline mist for 24 h, allow 2 h drying, then a further 24 h. Verify the test log shows a total of 50 h.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect immediately after the saline mist test. Pass if there is no excessive corrosion liable to impair efficiency.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After the corrosion test and a 48 h recovery, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'. Pass if RA is ≥ the Table 9 value and ≤ the Table 10 value.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples in a xenon tester per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and Table A6-1 for 500 h; verify the exposure log.

requirements.text: When test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer) is used, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed according to cycle No. 1 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with 102 min dry at a broadband (300 to 400 nm) irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m², a narrowband (340 nm) irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², a black-standard temperature of 65 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and a narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
requirements.test_case: Monitor the TM1 cycle parameters during exposure; pass if they stay within the stated tolerances under equilibrium.

requirements.text: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer) is used, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed according to cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with 102 min dry at a broadband (300 to 400 nm) irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m², a narrowband (340 nm) irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², a black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and a narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
requirements.test_case: Monitor the TM2 cycle parameters during exposure; pass if they stay within the stated tolerances under equilibrium.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): about 5 min after wiping with 70/30 n-heptane/toluol, inspect the surface visually; pass if there are no apparent surface changes (slight surface cracks acceptable).

requirements.text: The approval marking arrangement shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements in Annex 10 are given merely as examples.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval mark against paragraph 3.3. of UN R150; pass if the arrangement complies with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device must face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking; pass if the class symbol group is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation on the vehicle under normal conditions of use (paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.) and after vibration exposure; pass if mounting remains secure and photometric/geometric characteristics and installation positions remain compliant with R48.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting design and fixings of the installed lamp; pass if the lamp cannot be moved out of its correct position or orientation inadvertently (e.g. without tools or deliberate action).

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the M1 vehicle on a flat bearing plane and measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the bearing plane (e.g. with an inclinometer or 3D measurement). Pass if the deviation from parallel is within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp fitted to the vehicle, measure the horizontal angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, using a vehicle-coordinate 3D measurement. Check both the left-hand and the mirrored right-hand unit. Pass if the deviation from parallel is within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the rear combination lamp laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's fitting instructions and inspect the installed lamp against each instruction (mounting points, fasteners, orientation). Pass if every instruction is met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors of the left- and right-hand rear combination lamps) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on vehicle: measure the lateral position of the exterior geometrical form of the left and right units relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Drawing / visual comparison of the left and right units: pass if the exterior forms are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane. Interior structure is excluded from the check.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of each function on both units: pass if both units meet the same prescribed colour requirements (red for rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector; white for reversing lamp).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function on the left and right units at the same test points: pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical. Exception: a function approved as a matched pair is assessed as a pair instead.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level inspection of the rear: pass if there are at most two lateral logos (one per side) or one central logo.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the lamp: pass if any incorporated logo is a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo only.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of the preceding paragraphs on the installation of the rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation on the vehicle against the preceding installation requirements (e.g. symmetry of paired lamps about the longitudinal median plane). Pass if each requirement is met, or any deviation is limited to what the asymmetrical body shape makes unavoidable.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on M1 vehicle: verify each grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated function individually meets its colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements of R48; pass if all are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each lamp of the rear combination lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF; however, when the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric measurement of each function with all other functions OFF; for functions reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, measure colour with both switched ON; pass if values within the applicable limits.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp contains a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, it shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project apparent surface parts along reference axis onto plane tangent to outer lens; pass if projected area ≥ 60 % of smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or facing-edge gap between adjacent parts ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to reference axis.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Design review: verify functions sharing the housing/common outer lens are not declared or treated as an interdependent lamp system; pass if not so classified.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the rear position lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation (e.g. dimming, colour change, animation) occurs.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the stop lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Activate the stop lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation occurs.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the reversing lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Activate the reversing lamp at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period; pass if no intentional variation occurs.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear combination lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: If ambient-light-dependent variation is implemented, measure photometry and colour at each ambient-light state; pass if all states meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements of the applicable device regulation (e.g. UN R148).

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear combination lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure each function's photometry with the other functions switched ON and OFF in all combinations; pass if every resulting state complies with the applicable device regulation requirements (e.g. intensity limits and stop/position intensity ratio).

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp of the rear combination lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: For light sources shared between functions, measure photometry in each function mode; pass if each mode meets the technical provisions for that function.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector) fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Installation check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Annex 4, Zone 1); pass if no red light from the lamp is visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear position lamp, stop lamp or retro-reflector if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observer moving within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps, together with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp, can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check: operate the lighting switch and confirm the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) and the rear registration plate lamp. Repeat under each listed exception condition (parking lamps, side-marker flashing with direction indicators, DRL ON, front position lamp substitution per 5.12.1) to confirm that simultaneous switching is not required there. Pass: no independent switching outside the exception conditions.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the rear position lamp shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Applies only if the rear position lamp forms part of an interdependent lamp system. Energise and de-energise the rear position lamp function and observe all light sources of every interdependent lamp. Pass: all light sources switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Photometric/colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie inside the white area bounded by y = 0.150 + 0.640x, y = 0.440, x = 0.500, y = 0.382, y = 0.050 + 0.750x and x = 0.310.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric check of the light returned by the retro-reflector under standard illumination, measured through the outer lens. Pass if the chromaticity lies within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count the lamps of each function fitted (both handed units) and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specifications of UN R48 for each function; pass if the counts are equal.

requirements.text: Any lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, retro-reflector) may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on the M1 vehicle: if any lamp function is mounted on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.; pass if all conditions are fulfilled, or if no lamp is mounted on a movable component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", where fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed (stable or natural rest) position other than the normal position of use, and determine the hidden part of the rear position lamp apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", where fixed position of a movable component means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position other than the normal position of use and determine the hidden part of the retro-reflector apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps is not hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle check: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface, verify the additional lamps are switched ON and that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements of rear position lamps.

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors is not hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component is not practicable, additional devices satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the retro-reflectors shall be provided for when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflectors is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle check: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the retro-reflector apparent surface, verify additional retro-reflectors are effective and meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps is not hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable and additional lamps are not used, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the presence of a user notice in the vehicle stating that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the vehicle's presence (e.g. warning triangle); pass if notice present.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp), even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle. Each lamp function must be wired and connected to the vehicle harness. Each function must be made to operate by no more than installing a light source and/or a fuse. Fail if any lamp function needs other work to operate, because it is then deemed not present.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp function; verify replacement function is red, of similar main intensity and position to the failed rear position lamp, and that the replacement device (e.g. stop lamp) still performs its original function when activated.

requirements.text: During temporary replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with fail-safe replacement active; verify the dashboard tell-tale is activated indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., are allowed, provided that the intensity of all these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Activate each variable-intensity condition and measure luminous intensity of rear position and stop functions across the range; pass if both vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of stop and rear position intensities at multiple points across the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is maintained throughout.

requirements.text: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following environmental conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, and contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Review control strategy and measure intensity under each environmental condition input; pass if variation is triggered only by listed conditions and minimum/maximum intensities stay within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulation (e.g. R7/R148).

requirements.text: Independent from environmental conditions mentioned under 5.26.1., a decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level test varying speed and following-vehicle distance; pass if traffic-related intensity decrease activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and intensity remains within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: As long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h, the intensity decrease of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2 already activated under traffic conditions may remain active.
requirements.test_case: Activate the decrease below 20 km/h, then accelerate; pass if the decrease is cancelled no later than when speed exceeds 50 km/h.

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity of the rear position lamp of category R2 and stop lamp of category S2 shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during each intensity transition; pass if the change is gradual with no observable step or sharp variation.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition; pass if it does not exceed the voltage at which the device or function was approved, unless the device includes electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only UN R128 light sources.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 12 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 13.5 V + 3 % (13.905 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 6 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 % (6.9525 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except for devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in a representative constant voltage operating condition on a 24 V vehicle; pass if ≤ 28 V + 3 % (28.84 V), unless an exempting device configuration applies.

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp body, verify the terminal voltage limits of paragraph 5.27.2. are still met at the light-source supply.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle: observe the apparent surface of each function from infinity (or with parallel-shifted observation directions) over its prescribed angles of geometric visibility. Pass if no vehicle part obstructs any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1. Pass for using the reduced photometric field if the height is below 750 mm; then verify photometry down to 5° below the horizontal and confirm it conforms.

requirements.text: The LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions) does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Document check: if the LED module is non-replaceable, verify that the communication sheet of the component type approval states that the LED module is non-replaceable; if not so stated, verify the LED module is replaceable. Pass if non-replaceability is covered by that statement.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Document check: confirm that each lamp function holds a valid type approval to the device Regulation referenced in paragraph 6 of UN R48, and that the approval markings are present on the unit. Pass if every function is covered by a valid approval.

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps of the rear combination lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Design review: determine whether any light-signalling function incorporates a manufacturer logo. If it does, check for a valid UN R148 type approval that covers the lamp with the logo. Pass if the approval exists or no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device shall be optional.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the reversing lamp devices on the M1 vehicle; pass if 1 or 2 are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify a valid UN R23 (00 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) approval mark on the lamp; pass if present and valid.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the illuminating surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if the lower edge is >= 250 mm and the upper edge is <= 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per para. 2.10.7: pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° up to 5° down.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angle β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per para. 2.10.7 with two reversing lamps fitted: pass if each lamp is unobstructed over 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the reference axis of the lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: engage reverse gear with the propulsion system operable; pass if the lamp switches ON only when both conditions are met.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: disengage reverse, then separately set the propulsion system to non-operable; pass if the lamp does not switch ON or turns OFF in each case.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the R23/R148 component approval requirements; if a failure tell-tale is required, simulate a lamp failure; pass if the tell-tale indicates the failure.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on M1 category vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count S1/S2 stop lamps across the handed pair of rear combination lamps; pass if exactly two.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify a UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) approval for the stop lamp; pass if valid approval exists.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the apparent surface above ground on the unladen vehicle per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where the bodywork exception applies).

requirements.text: S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of vehicle: pass if stop lamps are located at the vehicle rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall have a horizontal angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check of the apparent surface on the vehicle: pass if unobstructed visibility over 45° outwards and 45° inwards (or 20° inwards under the H plane when mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: pass if unobstructed visibility 15° up and 15° down (or 5° down when mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The orientation of the stop lamp shall be towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installed lamp reference axis: pass if directed rearwards.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13/R13-H; pass if all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test with propulsion system switched off: stop lamp operation may be absent; pass if it functions in all positions where propulsion can operate.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirement; if required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: The installation of rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle and approval markings: pass if exactly two lamps (left and right handed units) with valid R7 (02+) or R148 (00+) approval.

requirements.text: There shall be no special requirement for the arrangement of the rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: No verification required.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from outermost apparent surface point to extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be placed above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of apparent surface above ground per para 5.8.1 on unladen vehicle; pass if 350–1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view of apparent surface over 45° in / 80° out (20° in below H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: verify unobstructed view over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If alternative chosen and rear side-marker fitted: verify unobstructed view over 45° out to 45° in (20° in below H plane if below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If alternative chosen: verify unobstructed view over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if below 750 mm).

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Determine unobstructed apparent surface in each limit direction excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear position lamp shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Functional check per para 5.11: rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with front position lamps and registration plate lamp; pass if compliant.
