requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of rear non-triangular retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle (left and right handed units) and approval markings: two retro-reflectors bearing valid R3 (02+) or R150 (00+) Class IA/IB approval; pass if both present and approved.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual/photometric assessment of any additional retro-reflecting devices or materials: pass if mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices' effectiveness is not impaired.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps), or ≤ 1,500 mm where bodywork shape justifies.

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: illuminating surface unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle: illuminating surface unobstructed 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: reference axis of retro-reflector directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Design review: shared surfaces with rear position/stop/reversing lamps are permitted; verify other requirements still met.

requirements.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (see paragraph 5.10.4. of this Regulation), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground and the red functions lit, an observer scans zone 1 between horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the rear position or stop lamp is directly visible to the front within that zone.

requirements.text: For the verification of the visibility of a red lamp to the front (see paragraph 5.10.4. of this Regulation), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
requirements.test_case: Construct the vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through the contact point(s) of the overall-width planes, using the foremost contact point for the forward plane and the rearmost for the rearward plane. Observe the lit red functions from within the zone bounded by these planes and by the 1 m and 2.2 m height limits. Pass if no red light is directly visible to the front.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured distances against individual installation specifications for each function; pass if all within limits.

requirements.text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured angles with individual specifications for each function, allowing ±3° per para 5.3.; pass if within limits including allowance.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Functional check against paras 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications (switching, activation conditions); pass if all conform.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector and their markings shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare inspected presence, number, colour (red/white), arrangement and category markings with paras 5.15., 5.16. and individual specifications; pass if all conform.
